performanceBottlenecks.message: Detected nested filter/find/some lookup inside component .map() loop. This leads to O(N^2) complexity. Extract mapping calculations using useMemo or pre-group data into O(1) maps.
Direct console logging inside component. This can spam the console and freeze the browser thread during high frequency renders.
Direct import of heavy visualization/editor module. Consider utilizing Next.js next/dynamic import to minimize bundle size and eliminate dashboard lag.
